members.title: Members
members.description: {count, plural, one {# person has} other {# people have}} access to {company}.
members.caption: Members of {company}

empty.title: No members yet
empty.waitDescription: People appear here once they accept their invitation.

changeOwnRole.title: Change your own role to {role}?
changeOwnRole.description: Only Admins manage {company}'s members. Another Admin can make you one again.

leave.label: Leave
leave.title: Leave {company}?
leave.description: You'll no longer be a member of {company}. Your account stays, and its Admins can invite you again.

remove.label: Remove
remove.title: Remove {user}?
remove.description: They'll lose access to {company}. Their account stays, and you can invite them again later.

invite.title: Invite by email
invite.description: They'll get an email with a link to join. The link works once and expires in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.

details.title: Details
details.description: The name everyone sees, and the address of its pages.

form.name: Name
form.slugDescription: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. The company's pages are at /companies/{slug}; changing it changes that address, and links with the old one stop working.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.deactivatedDescription: This company is deactivated. Reactivating gives its people access again; nothing was deleted.
danger.activeDescription: Its people lose access and can't raise requests until it's reactivated. Nothing is deleted.

requests.title: Requests · {company}
requests.deactivated: This company is deactivated. Its people have no access until it's reactivated, and its requests can only be read.
